summary: Test your battle skills in this offline sci-fi real-time strategy adventure!
description:
From the creators of the award-winner Kingdom Rush comes the most extraordinary offline space odyssey.

Fight challenging offline real time strategy battles on amazing and unknown planets. Command brave soldiers, mighty mechas, and powerful aliens against hordes of space monsters, swarms of insectoids, and robot armies in a galaxy far away. PLAN, ATTACK AND BEAT ALL THE ENEMIES ADAPTING YOUR STRATEGY by changing the role of your troops even in the thick of the offline combat. RECRUIT AND TRAIN THE GREATEST HEROES in the galaxy, leading them into dangerous territory against near-impossible odds. TURN THE TIDE OF BATTLE with orbital strikes, intelligent mines, support troops, turrets, and a wide array of special weapons. Armies of robots, crushed starships, gigantic monsters, unknown races, brave assaults, desperate rescues, audacious sabotages... the galaxy needs your command. The galaxy needs the Iron Marines.

GAME FEATURES

• 21 CAMPAIGN MISSIONS across 3 sci fi planets. Each action-packed offline challenge will make you improve your strategy to save the galaxy! Battle for victory through space in epic offline battles. • 20+ SPECIAL OPERATIONS that will test if you have what it takes to battle your way through space. If you need to play every challenge offline, go for it! • 14 HEROES with amazing powers are ready to follow your offline strategy. • 40+ UPGRADES to build the ultimate RTS army! Choose between Defense Drones, Napalm Rockets, Ricocheting Blasts, Lethal Weapons, and many more. • +7 UNITS to bring into battle and give your hero some extra firepower! • 8 SPECIAL WEAPONS to unleash hell on your enemies and keep expanding your tactics like space itself! What’s better than a well-placed missile? An orbital strike of 50 high-explosive missiles! • DEFEAT UNIQUE BOSSES in epic battles. They are green, mean, killing machines!!! Well… some are machines and these aliens aren’t green… but they’re all massive and determined to crush you. Suit up, Marines! • 70+ ACHIEVEMENTS to complete and show everyone you’re the best RTS commander in the whole galaxy (even offline). • NO WI-FI IN SPACE? No worries, offline play is guaranteed! Play Iron Marines offline whenever you want. • CHOOSE YOUR DIFFICULTY MODE: Casual, Normal or Veteran. Don’t get cocky! Or Do! Your choice! • IMPOSSIBLE MODE. Only for the most daring, reckless, all-out-of-bubblegum marines in space. We dare you! If you loved Kingdom Rush you will Love this offline strategy game! Iron Marines Awaits!
